brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps (market shows headroom at volume) and line up Manjushree as a second source

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on induction-wad caps, down from the market typical of ₹0.85–0.95/pc
priceAsk.basis: The market ask for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, and the verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — we spend ₹58.17 L a year, so we should be getting volume pricing

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no reason to extend

brief.financialLeverage: Suraj publishes no financials, so we can't see their cash position or how big we are to them. Our ₹58.17 L annual spend is meaningful but not huge. We have five strong alternates lined up — including Manjushree, India's largest rigid-plastic converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue — so our plan leans on competitive pressure and qualifying a second source, not on squeezing a supplier we can't see inside.

evidence.point: Market research shows room to move below typical pricing at volume
evidence.figure: 28 mm induction-wad PP cap ask band ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc, verdict MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec

evidence.point: We spend over half a crore a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
HDPE resin import price is a floor reference
We pay them 30 days after receipt, which is standard

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms — revenue ₹2569.83 Cr, health score B (65/100); top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, pharma — strong, profitable, a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging firm with broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: Suraj's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their stability — don't push so hard we destabilize a supplier we depend on
We have no internal price benchmark (no best-price-we-pay figure), so the market ask is our only anchor — verify it's apples-to-apples on spec and MOQ
The market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads to qualify — verify each before using them in an RFQ
If Suraj won't move on price, shifting ₹58.17 L to a second source takes time — start qualifying Manjushree now so we have real leverage in six months
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹58.17 L a year with you on caps and bottles, and the market's telling us there's room at ₹0.65–0.80 per piece at our volume — let's talk about how we get there together.
